baseline_workbook: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
task: Read-only bounded audit for durable, free, lawfully reusable outlet rating and review-count fields.

sources: Google Maps public listings / Google Maps Platform
scope.selection: First 20 directory rows with blank Rating / Review Count in current workbook, rows 2-21.

records_inspected.address: Address: 5 UPPER BOON KENG ROAD #01-01,KALLANG HEIGHTS,Singapore 380005

source_findings.field_semantics: Community-mapped tags; no dependable standardized public aggregate rating or review-count field for F&B outlets.
source_findings.freshness: Object edit timestamps are available in OSM data, but do not mean a rating was refreshed.
source_findings.reuse_constraints: ODbL 1.0 attribution and share-alike obligations apply to adapted databases; verify obligations before incorporating OSM-derived data into this workbook.
source_findings.exact_match_quality: Not evaluated per outlet because this source does not establish ratings/review counts as a consistent field.
source_findings.integration_recommendation: Do not populate Rating / Review Count from OSM. It may be considered for other fields only after separate license and exact-match review.

source_findings.source: Google Maps public listings / Google Maps Platform
source_findings.field_semantics: Ratings and review counts are Google Maps content and are platform-specific aggregates.
source_findings.freshness: Public pages may change; no stable point-in-time export or refresh timestamp verified for the inspected workbook sample.
source_findings.reuse_constraints: No clear open-data grant was found for copying Maps content into an external durable catalogue; use authorized API/display terms rather than scraping.
source_findings.exact_match_quality: No exact outlet probes performed because no reusable open export path was established.
source_findings.integration_recommendation: Do not scrape or persist rating aggregates. A licensed API workflow would require separate terms and cost review; no API calls made.

source_findings.field_semantics: Tripadvisor traveller rating and review metrics, distinct from all-customer or venue-wide satisfaction.
source_findings.freshness: Widgets are dynamic and may be changed by Tripadvisor without notice; capture dates would not create a durable refresh guarantee.
source_findings.reuse_constraints: Widget terms section 2.1 prohibit extracting widget/site content and displaying Tripadvisor ratings or reviews outside the widgets; API availability/pricing and license were not used.
source_findings.exact_match_quality: No exact outlet probes performed because the public widget terms block the required spreadsheet extraction/display use.
source_findings.integration_recommendation: Do not populate the workbook from scraped Tripadvisor pages/widgets. Consider only a separately licensed authorized feed with its display/attribution requirements satisfied.

summary.recommendation: Leave rating fields blank unless an outlet provides its own dated rating or a source provides a clearly reusable, exact-branch, dated rating dataset. If authorized delivery-platform scores are later accepted, preserve platform name, exact branch, capture timestamp, metric semantics, source URL, and explicit reuse permission; never label them venue-wide.

limitations: This is a bounded source/terms audit, not a verification of all Singapore outlets.
No page/API calls were made to collect ratings; no service spend or Mapbox requests occurred.
Public visibility alone is not treated as permission to copy metrics into a durable external database.
